title: Tapioca crepe with egg and Minas cheese
steps: Sift the tapioca starch evenly into a hot non-stick pan to form a round pancake.
Cook over medium heat for 1–2 minutes until it holds together, then flip.
Meanwhile scramble the eggs with a little salt in a second pan.
Put the eggs, crumbled cheese and diced tomato on one half, sprinkle with oregano and fold the pancake over.
